sets.relationshipLabel: A category and a kind of plant within it
sets.explanation: A tulip is a kind of flower, just as basil is a kind of herb — each pair names a broad category and one familiar member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: Same kind of gardening item, smaller then larger
sets.explanation: A planter is simply a bigger pot and a spade a bigger trowel, so each pair is the same tool scaled up.

sets.relationshipLabel: A plant part and a feature it bears
sets.explanation: A stem carries a bud and a leaf carries a vein — each pair names a plant structure and the feature that grows on it.

sets.relationshipLabel: One thing becomes another through a natural process
sets.explanation: A blossom ripens into fruit and a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly, each pair tracing a single natural process from start to finish.

glossary.definition: A small hand tool with a scoop-shaped blade, used for digging in tight spaces

definitions.definition: The colorful blooming part of a plant, often there to attract pollinators
A cup-shaped spring bloom that grows from a bulb
A leafy plant grown for its flavor or scent, often used in cooking
A fragrant green leafy plant often used in Italian cooking
A small container for growing a single plant
A larger container built to hold soil and several plants at once
A small hand tool with a scoop-shaped blade, used for digging in tight spaces
A larger, flat-bladed digging tool you push with your foot
The main stalk of a plant that holds it up and carries water and nutrients
A small swelling on a plant that opens into a leaf or flower
The flat green part of a plant that soaks up sunlight to make food
A thin line running through a leaf that carries water and nutrients
The flower a plant produces before it develops into something else
The fleshy, often edible part of a plant that grows to hold its seeds
A crawling, worm-like creature that eventually changes into a flying insect
A winged insect with colorful patterned wings that flits from flower to flower
